book.name: Romans
book.title: PAUL ka Mu Roman Numu Netammapu

content: E pupua'amu, umu e Jew numu namagwetzoina, nu unu oo soogwina ka Te Naa-matoo nanesootuha'e umu-koobatoo.
Nu mu sopedakwatoo umu ka Te Naa tu nakabetseana soogwa'epana, umu gi hownnekoo oo nakasopedakwatoo.
Umu puusoo besa too'e manepana, umu ka gi oo nakasopedakwadoona, soo Te Naa besa'yoo mee mu neakwu ka Te Pabe'e-wi mu tunaka'oedyukute.

Mu Jew-wi nanesootuhidu numu too'esoo namagwetzoipana ka pumme Jew nanesootuhi-wikoo, gi hownnekoo namagwetzoi-wa'ne'yoo. Soo Te Pabe'e yise meno'o atasoo te tunetammakute. Tamme Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukuna, o'no Te Naa mee te netammaku, “Besa'yoo,” o'no yise tamme namagwetzoikwu.
Soo ne Jew tumayohope ka Te Naa po ata'yoosoo. Soo Moses meeoo ka ne Jew tumayohope-witu botugu, “Tamme ka te tumayohope ooosapa nakabetseana, tamme namagwetzoikwu,” pana tamme gi oo mane-wa'ne'yoo.
Pana ka te tunaka'oedyukudu-witu oosoo besa te mayugwekwu meeoo nabotugu,

content.text: “Gi unu namanakwe, numu namagwetzoina. Gi tamme ka Te Pabe'e yaa teepu-koobatoo bise, oosoo te magwetzoikwu.
Gi tamme ka oo ya'e-kwikoo oo mayoda-wa'ne'yoo.
Mooasoo oo namanepu tamme mooasoo ooetu naka. Ekow meeoo na'unnedu tamme naka'oedyukuna.”

content: “Soo Jesus Te Pabe'e,” mee'e tamme unnena tamme oo tubetse naka'oedyukuna, soo Te Naa oo ya'e-wikoo oo mayodase, yise oosoo te magwetzoikwu.
Tamme ka tunaka'oedyukuna soo Te Naa, “Besa'yoo,” mee te netamma, tamme yise ka oo wahana, soo Te Naa te magwetzoa'e.
Mu tooe haga tooe ka Te Pabe'e tu namagwetzoina natuungudu nanakabetseadooa, mu Jew numu, mu gi Jew numu tuwazoo. Te Pabe'e pumatoo te nanesootuhidu no'oko te sootuha'e.

Ka gisoo Te Pabe'e-matoo mu nanesootuha'e soo Te Naa sakwa tooe haga tooe umu-matoo tayase umu yise umu-baa petugase, ka Te Naa unnepu mu tuukwe. Umu numu oo nakase ka Te Pabe'e-wi tunaka'oedyukuse, o'no yise oo-matoo nanesootuhikwu. Ka a nabotugu-kwa'nesoo,

content.text: “Besa mu numu ka petudyina, nu ka Te Naa besa unnena mu tuukwekwu.”

content: Umu Jew numu natuukwe'e, pana gi no'yoona ka Te Naa besa unnepu nakabetse'a. O'nosoo soo Te Naa yadooawabe Isaiah mee naneadu umu-witu bo'o mee'e,

content.text: “Huu'yoosoo numu oo naka'oedyukute ka pumme ne tuukwena.”

content: Mooasoo mu Jew numu ka Te Naa besa unnepu naka, mee'e natubotugu,

content.text: “Tooe hano tooe ka teepu-kooba soo Te Naa unnepu nawaha.”

content: Mu Jew numu ka Te Naa unnepu nakasopedakwatoo, pana gi nasootuhi, ka gisoo oo naka'oedyukuna. Soo Moses meeoo mu netamma,

content.text: “Umu numu, mu gi Jew numu mu nasootza'me sooyugwena umu meeoo unnena umuoo gi hee umuoo mu nasoodyagekwu ka Te Naa umuoo sootuha'e.”

content: Isaiah ka Te Naa unnena waha,

content.text: “Umu uga gi nu-matoo nanesootuhidu, gi uga e soomayudu pana meno'o nu mu natzapoonekute, umu yise e sopedakwatoo manepetu.”

content: Pana mu ka Jew numu-witu soo Te Naa meeoo unakwe,

content.text: “Nu ooosapa umuoo numu tuukwe'e nu mu sootuhikwu, pana umu gi e unnena nakabetse'a.”
